candidate.title: RAP
candidate.scope: RAP (RNA antisense purification), at the level of the assigned RAP row: lncRNA-associated chromatin, crosslinking/lysis, hybridization of biotinylated antisense probes, capture/washing/elution, and the drawn cDNA endpoint. The primary Engreitz et al. 2013 implementation resolves probe chemistry and recovery of associated genomic DNA. Its DNA-sequencing readout explains genomic localization but is not added as an unshown library branch. The adjacent CHART, GRO-seq/BRIC-Seq and clipped ChIRP rows are separate assays. RAP-RNA and other applications mentioned only in the secondary catalogue do not become additional target workflows.

operations.label: Crosslink and lyse cells

operations.information_effect: Retains RNA-associated chromatin through the transition from cells to lysate, making it available for RNA-directed capture.

operations.label: Hybridize biotinylated 120 bp antisense probes
operations.description: Biotinylated antisense probes hybridize to the lncRNA in crosslinked material. This adds an affinity handle to the target-containing complex through probe–target base pairing. The primary source specifies 120-nucleotide RNA probes tiled across the target, resolving the diagram’s 120 bp wording.
operations.mechanism: Sequence-complementary RNA–RNA hybridization between antisense RNA probes and the target lncRNA.
operations.information_effect: Probe sequence selects a known RNA target. Crosslinked material associated with that RNA can be recovered through the same capture handle; the probes are not themselves a direct map of genomic contact sites.

operations.label: Capture, wash and elute
operations.description: Biotin-dependent bead capture enriches probe-hybridized target complexes; washing and elution are grouped in the source caption. The primary method clarifies that captured chromatin complexes are eluted and crosslinks reversed. The output is recovered RNA-containing material that can also contain associated genomic DNA, rather than a claim that the faded chromatin has been discarded.
operations.mechanism: Biotinylated capture probes attach the target complex to streptavidin-coated beads. The primary methods specify streptavidin-coated magnetic beads; bead attachment is an intermediate within this combined block.
operations.information_effect: Enriches target RNA and material associated through the crosslinked complexes. It measures recovery of associations, without by itself resolving direct versus indirect RNA–DNA contact. Enrichment is imperfect: the paper reports other RNAs in the recovered fraction.

operations.label: PCR and reverse-transcribe
operations.description: The single final block labeled PCR and reverse-transcribe converts RNA in the recovered material into cDNA and includes amplification. The caption does not establish a PCR-before-reverse-transcription sequence. Only the RNA component supplies the template for the depicted cDNA; a separate DNA library route is not drawn.
operations.information_effect: RNA-derived cDNA carries sequence information about the recovered RNA population and can report target-RNA enrichment if sequenced. In the inspected primary study, sequencing recovered RNA assessed capture composition; genomic localization was obtained by sequencing co-purified genomic DNA. The drawing stops at cDNA and does not detail completion of a sequencing library.
